desc:
• CINNAMON CEREAL: Crispy cereal squares made from whole wheat and rice, blasted with epic cinnamon sugar CINNADUST; A morning food the whole family can enjoy

  • WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 16g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and a good source of calcium

  • BREAKFAST FOOD OR SNACK: Try it with or without milk as part of an easy breakfast; Serve some as a quick teen or kids snack; Pack some crispy cereal to go in a school snacks tote, lunch box, or backpack

  • SWEET TREATS: A delicious addition to homemade cereal bars, party mix, ice cream toppings, and other snacks for kids and adults; Keep a box in your pantry for any time you crave the cinnamon-y taste

  • CONTAINS: One 27 oz Giant Size box of Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cereal
features:
Features

Crispy Whole Grain Squares: Made from whole grain wheat and rice for a satisfying crunch in every bite.

Cinna-Dust Coating: Each square is generously coated with a blend of real cinnamon and sugar for bold, sweet flavor.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors: Made without artificial ingredients for a cleaner, more natural cereal experience.

Whole Grain Goodness: Provides 16 grams of whole grains per serving to support balanced nutrition.

Fortified with Vitamins & Minerals: Includes essential nutrients like calcium, vitamin D, iron, and B-vitamins.

Kid-Tested, Parent-Approved: Loved by kids for its taste and trusted by parents for its ingredients and nutritional value. 

Benefits

Flavor-Packed Breakfast: The sweet cinnamon-sugar taste is a morning favorite for both kids and adults.

Nutritious Start to the Day: Offers a mix of whole grains and fortified vitamins for lasting energy and daily health support.

Versatile Snack Option: Perfect with milk, as a dry snack, or added to trail mix and dessert recipes.

No Guilt Indulgence: Delivers sweet flavor without artificial additives or high-fructose corn syrup.

Great Texture: Crunchy texture holds up well in milk and makes it a satisfying snacking option anytime.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Rice Flour, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Dextrose, Salt, Cinnamon, Trisodium Phosphate, Soy Lecithin, Caramel Color, Rosemary Extract. BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
